entities.name: CbiN A8AEQ5
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Citrobacter koseri CbiN; identity and coverage 100%, E-value 4.15e-34.
CbiN is a substrate-capture component of the CbiMNOQ energy-coupling factor transporter complex.
Annotated as a multi-pass cell inner-membrane protein with cobalt ion transmembrane transporter activity.
Pfam CbiN domain PF02553.22 spans query positions 1–91 with i-Evalue 1.4e-36.

entities.name: CbiMNOQ transporter
observations: Energy-coupling factor transporter complex involved in cobalt import; includes ATP-binding CbiO, transmembrane CbiQ, and substrate-capture proteins CbiM/CbiN.

entities.name: Cobalt ion
observations: Transported substrate associated with CbiN-containing CbiMNOQ complex.

entities.name: Cobalamin biosynthesis
observations: CbiN-containing cobalt import supports the annotated cobalamin biosynthetic process.
